site.name: SafeHer

emergency.banner: Are you in danger right now?
emergency.title: Emergency Help
emergency.subtitle: If you are in immediate danger, call emergency services in your country
emergency.safe_word_desc: Use a code word with a trusted person to signal you need help without being overheard

hero.title: You Are Not Alone
hero.subtitle: Millions of women worldwide face gender-based violence every day. SafeHer provides real emergency numbers, resources, and support for women everywhere — in every language.

hotlines.title: Find Help in Your Country
hotlines.subtitle: Real emergency numbers and helplines for 80+ countries

resources.title: Resources & Support
resources.subtitle: Find help near you
resources.domestic_violence_desc: Shelters, hotlines, and legal aid for survivors of domestic abuse
resources.sexual_assault_desc: Confidential support, counseling, and reporting resources
resources.mental_health_desc: Counseling, therapy resources, and peer support groups
resources.legal_aid_desc: Free and low-cost legal assistance for protection orders and rights
resources.shelter_desc: Emergency and transitional housing for women and children
resources.economic_desc: Financial assistance, job training, and economic independence resources

safety.title: Safety Tips
safety.subtitle: Knowledge is power — protect yourself and others
safety.digital_1: Use strong, unique passwords and enable two-factor authentication
safety.digital_2: Be cautious about sharing your location on social media
safety.digital_3: Know how to quickly delete your browsing history
safety.digital_4: Use encrypted messaging apps (Signal, WhatsApp) for sensitive conversations
safety.digital_5: Check your devices regularly for tracking or spy software
safety.digital_6: Use a private browser window or incognito mode when researching help
safety.physical_1: Trust your instincts — if something feels wrong, it probably is
safety.physical_2: Share your location with a trusted friend or family member when going out
safety.physical_3: Keep emergency numbers memorized, not just saved in your phone
safety.physical_4: Plan and practise escape routes from your home and workplace
safety.physical_5: Keep copies of important documents in a safe place outside your home
safety.physical_6: Prepare an emergency bag with essentials you can grab quickly

safety_plan.title: Build Your Personal Safety Plan
safety_plan.subtitle: A step-by-step guide to creating your own safety plan. Your answers stay in your browser only — nothing is saved to any server.

legal.title: Know Your Rights
legal.subtitle: Legal protections exist for you — learn what they are
legal.protection_orders_desc: You have the right to seek a restraining order or protection order against an abuser in most countries
legal.workplace_desc: Harassment and discrimination based on gender is illegal in most countries — you can report it
legal.immigration_desc: Gender-based persecution and domestic violence may qualify you for asylum or special visa protections
legal.child_custody_desc: Your rights as a parent are protected — learn about custody rights and how to keep children safe

community.title: You Belong Here
community.subtitle: Connect with other women, share your story, find strength in community
community.forum_desc: A safe, moderated space to share experiences and find support from others who understand
community.stories_desc: Read stories of strength and resilience from women around the world
community.volunteer_desc: Help other women by volunteering your time, skills, or resources
community.donate_desc: Support organizations that protect and empower women worldwide

footer.crisis: In crisis? Call 112 (international) or your local emergency number
footer.mission: SafeHer is dedicated to supporting women facing gender-based violence and hardship worldwide. Every woman deserves safety.
footer.escape_tip: Press Escape at any time to quickly leave this site
